question: The bill which provide for the trial of British or European person by Indians was _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ilbert Bill**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Ilbert Bill' was introduced in 1883 under the Viceroyship of Lord Ripon.

 
 
• Ilbert Bill was drafted by Sir Courtenay Ilbert on 9th February 1883 during the viceroyship of Lord Rippon.
 
• The main objective behind the introduction of this bill is to allow Indian judges to try cases in session courts involving Britishers.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The introduction of the bill had roused anger and resentment among people, especially English women and British tea and indigo planters in Bengal.
 
• English women argued that Bengali women were not respected by their male counterparts, so they shouldn't get the power to try cases involving Britishers.
 
• On the contrary, Bengali women who supported the bill said that they were more educated and had good academic records than English Women.
